803:t_1:87.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「I expect Miss $$スズネ$$ to go wherever $n goes as well.」

803:t_1:88.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「$$アドヴェント#pilot$$ also seems to regard $n as special. We should be careful.」

803:t_1:89.en:
$$シャア$$
「What do you plan to do, $$ブライト$$?」

803:t_1:91.en:
$$ブライト$$
「Assign him to the Japan Defense Force.」
「Assign him to the $$ネオ・ジオン$$ containment force.」
「Assign him to the $$アマルガム$$ pursuit force.」

803:t_1:92.en:
$$ブライト$$
「Japan will play a crucial role in our coming counteroffensive. We'll have him help defend it too.」

803:t_1:93.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「Understood. I'll make the arrangements.」

803:t_1:94.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「If this deployment succeeds, $$エクリプス$$ will enter its final phase.」

803:t_1:95.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Take $$ラース・バビロン$$... Defeat Emperor $$アウストラリス$$ and the $$リアクター$$s, and free those trapped by the $$霊子吸収システム$$...」

803:t_1:96.en:
$$ブライト$$
「That will be the day Earth is liberated. Keep that in mind as you carry out your duties.」

803:t_1:97.en:
$$ブライト$$
「Unless we stop $$ネオ・ジオン$$, this war is certain to drag on. We'll have him join that mission too.」

803:t_1:98.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「Understood. I'll make the arrangements.」

803:t_1:99.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「If this deployment succeeds, $$エクリプス$$ will enter its final phase.」

803:t_1:100.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Take $$ラース・バビロン$$... Defeat Emperor $$アウストラリス$$ and the $$リアクター$$s, and free those trapped by the $$霊子吸収システム$$...」

803:t_1:101.en:
$$ブライト$$
「That will be the day Earth is liberated. Keep that in mind as you carry out your duties.」

803:t_1:102.en:
$$ブライト$$
「It's dangerous to leave $$アマルガム$$ unchecked after their development of $$時空震動弾$$s. We'll have him join that mission too.」

803:t_1:103.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「Understood. I'll make the arrangements.」

803:t_1:104.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「If this deployment succeeds, $$エクリプス$$ will enter its final phase.」

803:t_1:105.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Take $$ラース・バビロン$$... Defeat Emperor $$アウストラリス$$ and the $$リアクター$$s, and free those trapped by the $$霊子吸収システム$$...」

803:t_1:106.en:
$$ブライト$$
「That will be the day Earth is liberated. Keep that in mind as you carry out your duties.」

803:t_1:110.en: ～Inside the Imperial Capital, $$ラース・バビロン$$～

803:t_1:111.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「...Well, they got me. $c is getting stronger.」

803:t_1:114.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「Now that I can finally talk freely, can't we be a little more cheerful? Come on.」

803:t_1:115.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「You're asking the impossible of these guys.」

803:t_1:116.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Watch your mouth, amateur. You're only here as a matter of convenience.」

803:t_1:117.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「You're stingy. There are twelve chairs here, so there's plenty of room, isn't there?」

803:t_1:118.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「Exactly. Being here alone with two gloomy men is suffocating.」

803:t_1:119.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「What is $$アウストラリス$$ doing?」

803:t_1:120.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「His official duties. His Majesty the Emperor is busy.」

803:t_1:124.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「I'm used to dealing with cheeky little boys.」

803:t_1:126.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「Now, now! No losing your temper for real! We're $$リアクター$$s, united by an unbreakable bond.」

803:t_1:129.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「Ignoring your Supreme Commander isn't very nice...」

803:t_1:131.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「There's nothing else to report. It's just as I said. They're definitely getting stronger.」

803:t_1:132.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「Compared to when they struggled against $$ガドライト#pilot$$ inside the dimensional cage, their progress is incredibly fast.」

803:t_1:133.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「In a way, it's thanks to you. When you hold them down, they have a habit of pushing back harder than ever.」

803:t_1:134.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「You're awfully partial to them.」

803:t_1:135.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「It's better than being obsessed with one person... one woman, to be precise, isn't it?」

803:t_1:137.en:
$$尸空#pilot$$
「$$バルビエル$$. Don't bother with this woman.」

803:t_1:138.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「Exactly. $c has returned to $$蒼の地球$$. Let's have all the fun we can.」

803:t_1:139.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Indeed. Crushing their arrogance wouldn't be bad.」

803:t_1:140.en:
$$尸空#pilot$$
「Their actions will also stir the grotesque gods targeting this planet.」

803:t_1:141.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「They bring battle wherever they go... They really are a singularity.」

803:t_1:142.en:
$$尸空#pilot$$
「That is why they bear the $$烙印$$. ...Just as we do.」

803:t_1:143.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
(Now then... $c, $n... These guys are serious now.)

803:t_1:144.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
(Can you really beat them...?)

803:t_1:148.en: ～$$ラース・バビロン$$　Imperial Palace～

803:t_1:149.en:
$$グエン$$
「...That concludes my report on the activities of the forces under $$クロノ$$'s control.」

803:t_1:152.en:
$$アウストラリス$$
「$$グエン・サード・ラインフォード$$... Why did you join $$クロノ$$?」

803:t_1:153.en:
$$アウストラリス$$
「I am told that $$クロノ$$'s core membership is hereditary, and vacancies are only filled under exceptional circumstances.」

803:t_1:154.en:
$$グエン$$
「...Perhaps it was a kind of resignation.」

803:t_1:156.en:
$$グエン$$
「I learned how the world would end through a means other than the $$黒の英知$$.」

803:t_1:157.en:
$$アウストラリス$$
「The book called 《$$メトロポリス$$》...」

803:t_1:158.en:
$$グエン$$
「I am merely a small man, without the sense of duty possessed by $$クロノ$$'s $$キング$$.」

803:t_1:159.en:
$$グエン$$
「But even a small man wishes to witness the end of the human species on Earth in his own way.」

803:t_1:160.en:
$$アウストラリス$$
「You have attained a detached understanding.」

803:t_1:161.en:
$$グエン$$
「It is nothing so grand. I merely know my own limitations.」

803:t_1:163.en:
$$グエン$$
「If I have relieved Your Majesty's boredom, I am honored. ...Now, if you will excuse me.」

803:t_1:164.en:
$$アウストラリス$$
「One who witnesses the end of a species...」

803:t_1:165.en:
$$執務官$$
「Your Majesty... The next visitor is waiting.」

803:t_1:168.en:
$$アウストラリス$$
「State your name, woman.」

803:t_1:169.en:
$$シオニー$$
「My name is $$シオニー・レジス$$.」

803:t_1:170.en:
$$シオニー$$
「I requested an audience because I have something I wish to tell Your Majesty today.」
